_comment: The words a wire dateline ends in, just before its closing bracket, as in （中央社首爾29日綜合外電報導） or （中央社記者…電）. degrade.strip_dateline builds its pattern from them: the bracket pair at the very start of the text, its length cap and the day of the month it must carry are the shape, in code; these are the words. Add a wire's own closing word here, never a regex.
